meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, national level)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified; commercial matters governed by Código de Comercio)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia – United States Trade Promotion Agreement (2012)
Colombia – United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement (2021)
Colombia – Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty (1995/2005, as ratified)
Andean Community Decision 578 – Foreign Capital and Investment Regime

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Article 44 of Ley 1955 de 2019; Decreto 830 de 2021 (Beneficiario Final / UBO regulation); DIAN Resolución 000164 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB); Ley 526 de 1999 (Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero - UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Decreto 2555 de 2010 and Circular Básica Jurídica (Circular Externa 029 de 2014), Part I, Title IV (SARLAFT) as amended by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of each direct and indirect corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for countries party to the 1961 Hague Convention) or Consular Legalization by a Colombian Consulate (for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the legal representative and the SARLAFT compliance officer of the Colombian S.A.S.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or corporate secretary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization, followed by Colombian notary registration

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and tax residence certificates of all final natural-person beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority and national tax authority of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copies + Apostille or Consular Legalization (foreign documents); Colombian notary certification for domestic

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements or bank solvency reference of the parent company / ultimate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent external auditor or issuing bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization plus bank signatory verification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record certificate / police clearance certificate of each natural-person shareholder and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national police or court records authority of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization, with Spanish translation by certified translator in Colombia if necessary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-registration screening of all shareholders, UBOs, legal representatives, board members, senior management, and compliance officers against: (i) OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list; (ii) the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) the UIAF/Colombian criminal and terrorist financing lists; (iv) FATF public statements and jurisdictions under increased monitoring; and (v) Colombian and international Politically Exposed Persons registers in conformance with SARLAFT. Adverse media and negative news checks are required, and the complete screening evidence file must be available for SFC inspection before a securities brokerage license is granted.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) – Confecámaras portal (www.rues.org.co), processed through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Spanish or an alphabet transliteration compatible with the Spanish registry. Accents and ñ are permissible but the registry system normalizes to the Latin alphabet; acronyms must be fully spelled out on first registration. All proposed names must be distinct from existing registrations and not giving rise to confusion with regulated financial terms.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Cámara de Riesgo Central de Contraparte
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) with the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days of notification, attaching the original homonymy certificate and revised name alternatives. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file a second-instance appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 5 business days. The appeal must include the registration fee receipt and a certified copy of the rejection decision; no new trademarks may be introduced at the appellate stage.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for a securities brokerage entity. A licensed broker operating under Decreto 2555 de 2010 must maintain a physical, client-accessible registered office in Colombia staffed during business hours; virtual office services are not acceptable for domicile, archive maintenance, or regulatory communication.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (quantified >75% probability of an unannounced Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia inspection within the first 18 months of license operation; UIAF and DIAN may also conduct visits)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonymy certificate (certificado de homonimia) in RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory chamber tariff per Confecámaras fee regime

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: S.A.S. incorporation document drafting and notarization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary (Notaría) of Bogotá and local counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial statutory tariff plus prevailing market legal fee for corporate drafting

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration of S.A.S. (Registro Mercantil) and filing with the Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on paid-in capital threshold

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization of shareholder and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent foreign authority (Hague Apostille) or Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document treaty or consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIT (tax identification number) registration with DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO Registry (RUB) initial filing and DIAN validation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No state fee; prevailing market compliance agent fee for data submission

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Securities brokerage license pre-filing dossier and SARLAFT/AML program
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and external AML counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: SFC application tariff plus prevailing market benchmark for AML compliance review

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening software subscription and negative media checks (6-month term)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party screening vendor (e.g., Reuters World-Check, LexisNexis, or equivalent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark subscription fee for financial institution due diligence

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regime, Arts. 1-45); Código de Comercio de Colombia (Decreto 410 de 1971), Arts. 98-139; Ley 964 de 2005 (Mercado de Valores), Arts. 11-20; Decreto Único Reglamentario 2555 de 2010, Parts 3 and 5
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución e Inscripción en el Registro Mercantil (executed before two witnesses or notarized)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Law 1258/2008; payment may be deferred up to two years. However, the SFC brokerage authorization (Decree 2555/2010) requires the full payment and escrow of minimum equity capital of approximately COP 4.7 billion (≈ USD 1.15 million) for retail commission brokers, held unencumbered in a segregated escrow account at a supervised Colombian credit institution until the operating authorization is granted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: CONSIDERANDO: the incorporation instrument certified the subscribed shares and initial capitalization; the registered office was established; and the Company requires governance of its statutory administration. RESUELVE: FIRST — Confirm and record the payment and subscription of the representative shares and the transfer of capital to the Company's segregated bank account at a supervised Colombian credit institution. SECOND — Establish the registered office at the address indicated in the incorporation documents, designating the legal representative for compliance and notices. THIRD — Appoint the legal representative and statutory auditor, delegating powers to execute administrative, tax and banking formalities and to implement the corporate governance and AML policy. FOURTH — Instruct preparation of the first annual report and the filing with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation and Homonym Check of Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online homonym and similarity search through RUES; present up to three alternative corporate names (e.g., 'XYZ Offshore Securities S.A.S.') with the intended activity code 6611; pay the nominal reservation fee; obtain the Certificado de Homonimia valid for 30 business days and attach it to the incorporation package.
required_dossiers: Online name-search application form
Identification data of the promoters or shareholders
Indicator of ISIC 6611 commercial activity
Name reservation fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration, the Chamber proposes acceptable alternatives; the applicant re-submits a revised name within the validity window and obtains a renewed homonym certificate at no additional registry fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of By-Laws (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría de Circuito (optional for real-estate contributions; private document with two witnesses permitted under Law 1258/2008)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the by-laws covering corporate name, domicile, broad corporate purpose including ISIC 6611 brokerage activities, share classes, capital subscription terms, administration and representation rules, audit provisions, arbitration clause, duration, and first legal representative. Execute the document before two witnesses or a notary; retain the original for mercantile registration.
required_dossiers: Draft by-laws (estatutos sociales)
Passports or national IDs of non-resident shareholders
Power-of-attorney and entity documentation for corporate shareholders
Capital contribution schedule and bank payment instructions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiencies in representation powers or capital contribution details are cured by executing an addendum to the by-laws and re-executing the instrument; no registry sanction is imposed if corrective execution is completed before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration and Issuance of Existence Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Mercantil (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed by-laws through the RUES system, authenticate the signatures as required, pay the mercantile registration fee and the applicable registration tax on capital, and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal evidencing the legal personality of the S.A.S.
required_dossiers: Executed copy of the incorporation document
RUES registration form with company data and legal representative designation
Tax information form (definitive RUT resolved at DIAN after registration)
Proof of payment of inscription fee and registration tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an objection (e.g., incomplete object clause or missing authentication), a corrective addendum is presented within the suspension term and the file is re-submitted via RUES; cure within 30 days avoids any sanction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: NIT and RUT Registration with the Tax Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (MUISCA virtual platform)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the chamber registration, the legal representative completes the RUT form on the DIAN MUISCA portal, attaches the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, and requests the NIT assignment and the applicable tax regime classification (ordinary income taxpayer, withholding-agent status, and VAT responsibility subject to activity code 6611). The stamped or electronic RUT is archived in the corporate file.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Copy of the legal representative's ID and appointment
Registered company address, email, and phone contact
Bank account evidence and capital escrow certificate if requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Discrepancies in tax classification are cured by filing a RUT rectification through the MUISCA platform; the updated RUT is issued within one business day, and high-risk regime flags are resolved by submitting the pending SFC authorization record.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Securities Brokerage Authorization Filing with the Financial Market Supervisor
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) — Delegatura para Intermediarios de Valores
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for the SFC operating authorization ('Autorización de Funcionamiento') for a Sociedad Comisionista de Bolsa under ISIC 6611, presenting the business plan for equities, CFDs and derivative instruments, the SARLAFT AML/CFT manual, the solvency report evidencing the escrowed minimum equity, the corporate governance code, and the designated compliance officer profile. Submit via the SFC virtual user portal and attend the on-site verification inspection when scheduled.
required_dossiers: Incorporation file and Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Detailed business plan covering equities, CFDs and derivatives
SARLAFT manual and compliance officer (oficial de cumplimiento) designation
Capital solvency certificate and segregated escrow account statement
Background declarations and good-standing letters for shareholders and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: SFC requirements ('requerimientos de información') are answered within 10 business days with supplementary capital and compliance evidence; if the authorization is denied, a revised application may be re-filed after one year once the capital structure and AML governance are materially corrected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Final Corporate Formalities — Books Legalization and AML Implementation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá; DIAN; UIAF (Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero); local banking compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the official accounting and corporate books (registro de libros oficiales) before the Chamber of Commerce; implement the SARLAFT program and employee induction; open operating bank accounts with segregated client money trust arrangements; file the initial AML registration through the UIAF electronic platform; and legalize the signature of the legal representative before the bank.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Designation of legal representative and compliance officer
SARLAFT manual, internal code of conduct and risk matrix
Bank reference letter and client-money trust agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late legalization of books within two months of registration attracts a small fine payable with the late-filing surcharge; AML documentation gaps are cured by submitting supplementary risk matrices and evidence to the SFC and UIAF within the required response window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for financial brokerage licensing; Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente and Curaduría Urbana for physical office establishment
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de Constitución y Funcionamiento — Sociedad Comisionista de Bolsa de Valores (regulated broker registration under Article 11, Law 964 de 2005 and Decree 2555 de 2010)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA (Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales) for national-scale projects; for this office-based brokerage operation, scrutiny delegated to Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente / CAR regional authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III — EIA Registration Exempt (low-impact office and fintech data activities; no industrial emission or effluent sources)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC discharge generated; office sanitation complies with Resolución 0631 de 2015 (pH 6-9, residual chlorine ≤ 0.5 mg/l where applicable); ambient air quality per Resolución 2254 de 2017; electronic waste disposal under Resolution 1512 de 2010 (RAEE); solid waste management per Law 1259 de 2008.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos (emergency exits, extinguishers, and evacuation plan); structural load inspection and land-use certificate (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) issued by the Curaduría Urbana; occupational health and safety program (SG-SST) per Resolution 0312 de 2019; registration of employees and the legal representative with an ARL administrator of occupational risks.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – MUISCA electronic portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign-owned S.A.S. must incorporate by private document recorded with the Chamber of Commerce, obtain the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation, and then register in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) electronically through DIAN's MUISCA portal. A domiciled legal representative (and, for e-invoicing, an electronic signature) is required. DIAN issues the NIT upon completion of RUT registration, without requiring a prior physical visit for entities with non-resident shareholders. For regulated brokerage services, the legal representative must also present the Financial Superintendency authorization to DIAN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - the S.A.S. is a separate Colombian income tax resident; no pass-through status is available for foreign or domestic shareholders.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists under Colombian law. Tax classification is mandatory. Anti-hybrid and hybrid mismatch rules (ET Article 124-3) are imposed automatically; entities may elect the use of accelerated depreciation and VAT exemption criteria only in the sense permitted by the Tax Statute. For VAT export services, taxpayers must request in the RUT the condition of 'export service provider' to claim zero-rating.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 3,500 UVT per calendar year (approximately COP 174 million for fiscal year 2025). For securities brokerage activities, registration is nevertheless mandatory if any taxable or exempt activity is carried out, because financial service providers are treated as obligated VAT subject.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing ('factura electrónica de venta') is mandatory for all VAT registrants. The taxpayer must use an authorized web service, transmitting each invoice in XML to DIAN in real time; DIAN validates and returns a unique code (CUFE) which must appear on the invoice. Clearance must be completed before the invoice is issued. Since 2022, digital stamping is also required for travel and export documentation, and each transaction must be serviced through DIAN's 'Facturación Electrónica' and 'Documento Soporte' applications.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies only to exports of tangible goods and to services expressly listed in Article 481 of the Tax Statute (e.g., software, call centers, tourism and certain BPO/KPO services). For an offshore securities brokerage, commission and intermediary fees are outside the statutory list. As a result, the service is either exempt under Article 476 (if rendered by a supervised financial entity) or standard-rated at 19% when provided by a commercial S.A.S. without Financial Superintendency consolidation. To claim zero-rating, a taxpayer must first be recognized as an 'export service provider' on the RUT, demonstrate that the service is received and used wholly abroad, and submit a formal request to DIAN before carrying out the activity. A prior favorable case-by-case ruling is the only safe route for brokerage fees.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación F500) applicable to goods-linked transactions
Commercial Invoice / Export Service Contract executed with the non-resident client
Bill of Lading (for goods) or Equivalent Service Use Certificate (Certificado de uso en el exterior) signed by the foreign recipient
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de canalización de divisas) issued by a local bank
Power of Attorney / Certificate of Legal Representation for the S.A.S. and the DIAN export authorization (VUE - Registro de Vendedores de Servicios) if relying on Article 481
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN will claw back zero-rated VAT if the exporter does not retain and present the customs or service documentation, fails to prove actual inbound FX remittance within the 180-day window, or the destination/offshore use is not credible. The penalties include an 'inexact penalty' of up to 160% of the underpaid VAT, 36% interest, and, in fraudulent cases, criminal sanctions for tax evasion under Article 402 of Colombia's Criminal Code. Additionally, the taxpayer may lose the RUT export-provider status and be barred from claiming VAT refunds on its input costs for the subsequent fiscal year.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Banca Central de Colombia); foreign exchange administration is exercised by the same central bank under Resolución Externa No. 1 de 2018, with supplementary enforcement by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a floating exchange system with an active domestic forward market. Current-account operations (including brokerage fee settlements, commission remittances, and related service payments) are freely convertible, but every physically exchanged currency transaction must be routed through an authorized intermediary del mercado cambiario and supported by the appropriate Declaración de Cambio (currently Formulario No. 5). Capital-account operations, including capital injections, foreign loans, and the establishment of foreign investments in a Colombian entity, are likewise convertible but conditioned on registration with Banco de la República and ongoing compliance with the investment registration certificate (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales). Profit remittance is permissible without quantitative ceilings, provided the underlying investment has been registered, Colombian withholding taxes (including dividend withholding tax at source) have been settled, local financial statement audits are up to date, and the foreign exchange proceeds are channeled through a Colombian authorized bank using the allocated investment liquidation purpose code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For services export proceeds (which include brokerage and agency commissions earned by the S.A.S from foreign clients), the statutory channeling obligation requires the Colombian exporter to channel the foreign currency through the authorized foreign exchange system within six months from the date of receipt of the payment. For goods exporters the analogous deadline runs from the shipment/export declaration date, normally six months unless a longer payment term beyond six months is contractually justified and declared. There is no mandatory conversion ratio: the exporter may maintain 100% of the channeled foreign currency in a local foreign-currency account with an authorized intermediary, may sell it voluntarily to the banking system, or may use it within Colombia for legal current-account obligations. The obligation is to 'canalizar' (route) the proceeds, not to surrender them to the central bank or government; nevertheless, non-channeling or late channeling gives rise to exchange-regime fines and adverse AML/CFT reputation flags.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Segregated Client Money Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating is LOW. Colombian law and SFC prudential rules require securities brokerage, escrow, and client-money segregation to be handled by local Colombian licensed credit institutions. Offshore electronic-money institutions (EMIs), foreign virtual account providers, and cross-border fintech rails cannot lawfully open segregated client accounts for Colombian resident brokerage operations, and Banco de la República channeling rules do not recognize them as authorized mercados de cambio. An offshore EMI account may be used only as an auxiliary treasury console outside Colombia for purely administrative inflows that are not subject to Colombian exchange-channeling, but it cannot serve as the primary operational or client-money custody rail for the Colombian S.A.S. without regulatory non-compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners are normally required to appear physically at the bank's corporate onboarding desk or at an SFC-authorized delegation venue. For a non-resident-controlled S.A.S. carrying out retail securities brokerage, the standard posture of Tier-1 Colombian banks is in-person presence for the legal representative, at least one certifying shareholder, and all material beneficial owners, together with an identity and source-of-funds interview. Remote onboarding is statutorily possible only where the client is an already-known institutional investor, the risk rating is and remains low, and a biometric video-identification protocol is available; for this high-risk special-license sub-sector remote opening is generally unavailable without prior onboarding at a foreign correspondent bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: 'Offshore securities brokerage' carries an SFC-recognized high-risk asset class, heightened PEP/Sanctions exposure, and transaction-pattern unpredictability.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SFC brokerage license; AML/CFT manual approved by compliance officer; transactional monitoring policy; certified board resolution adopting the AML manual; evidence of monitored segregated client accounts; annual AML/CFT audit reports; and an enhanced due-diligence file with the bank's institutional onboarding form.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Non-transparent beneficial-ownership cascade, especially if any owner holds shares through nominee or bearer-arrangement jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full register of ultimate beneficial owners (UBO) with passport/biometric copies, birth certificates, corporate track record, declarations of non-nomination, tax residency certificates, and an organizational chart back-to-back down to natural-person owners, all notarized and apostilled.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Inconsistent source-of-funds for the initial capital escrow account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified records of the parent-entity treasury, executed shareholder loan/investment agreements, SWIFT references of the inbound capital wire, confirming that funds derive from legitimate foreign brokerage activities, plus audited consolidated financial statements of the ultimate parent and foreign tax return acknowledgements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Sanctions/PEP screening hit or name-matched judgment on foreign shareholders or counterparty broker-dealers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent screening output from a SFC-compliant sanctions system, disambiguation evidence, juridical identity checking, official beneficial-ownership certificate from a recognized valid registry, a detailed litigation-history narrative, and legal opinion from a licensed Colombian counsel on the non-application of restrictive measures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Lack of Colombian physical substance and perceived absence of operational local nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Colombia-domiciled lease/service contract, registered principal place of business, national payroll or service agreements with local administrators, permanent legal representative appointment in Colombia, presence of local payment and treasury officers, and evidence of banking with an SFC-authorized compliance unit.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital contributions must be routed via SWIFT MT103 to a Banco de la República-authorized local bank, with the beneficiary account being the S.A.S. capital-escrow account. The sender must be a non-resident entity in the banking system and must include the precise RUT (Colombian tax ID) of the S.A.S., the corporate resolution, and the Banco de la República purpose code applicable to 'Inversión directa de no residentes'. After receipt, the S.A.S. compliance officer must file the foreign-exchange declaration (Formulario No. 5) on the local bank’s channel, attaching the investment registration certificate issued by the Banco de la República (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales). The bank will verify the SWIFT remittance against the motif 'Aportes de capital' and will not allow further allocation until the registration is complete.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for trade settlements and commission payments shall be made through the S.A.S.’s authorized Colombian clearing bank using SWIFT MT103 messages for ordinary value transfers (e.g., foreign broker-dealer commissions, clearing fees, custody charges), with the corresponding Banco de la República exchange registration code for 'Pagado de comisiones' / 'Servicios de intermediación'. If physical commodity flows are intermediated alongside the securities brokerage, the commercial-letter-of-credit route (MT700 with MT707 amendment) may be used; all documentary credits require the underlying trade contract, the invoice, and the exchange declaration at the time of negotiation. Outbound dividend or profit remittances must use the registered investment-liquidation code and must be preceded by local corporate-tax evidence of satisfaction of the Colombian dividend withholding and net-worth compliances.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC COP/USD foreign-exchange forwards (deliverable) executed with SFC-authorized Colombian banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only where there is a proven unfulfilled sovereign-capital-control exposure and a Colombian intermediary is selected
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps between COP and USD
European-style FX options (plain vanilla) on USD/COP written by authorized local credit institutions
Exchange-traded foreign-currency futures on offshore venues as redemption-hedges ancillary to the brokerage book

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between January 1 and March 31 pursuant to Article 34 of the Colombian Commercial Code.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a statutory surcharge on the registry fee; failure to renew for 12 consecutive months results in administrative cancellation of the mercantile registration and compulsory dissolution of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certified Annual Financial Statements (Estados Financieros Certificados)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio; financial statements are also reviewed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and, for licensed securities intermediaries, filed with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31, presented together with the commercial registry renewal, following approval by the Shareholders' Assembly within one month of the fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit of financial statements blocks the registry renewal; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose fines of up to 50 SMMLV (approx. USD 17,000) for late or misleading filings; directors incur joint liability for resulting corporate damage.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Reconfirmation (Autorreporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (electronic UBO registry platform) and DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) as part of the AML financial-information framework.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31, concurrent with the commercial registry renewal; any qualifying shareholding or control change requires updated filing within two months of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False, incomplete, or late UBO statements expose the company to fines per violation (up to USD 17,000 equivalent) and to restrictions in registry services, including ineligibility to record share transfers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: DIAN Transfer Pricing Informative Return and Support Documentation (Formas 2446, 2447, 2448)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually for the preceding fiscal year; for calendar-year taxpayers, Form 2446 is generally due June 15 and Forms 2447/2448 on July 15 under the DIAN Resolution filing calendar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or material inaccuracy may trigger DIAN fines of up to 20% of the transfer-pricing adjustment, plus monetary penalties computed on transaction value and default interest from the original tax due date.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory independent auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory for any Colombian S.A.S. meeting at least one 2025 threshold: gross assets exceeding 3,000 SMMLV (~USD 1.16M), gross revenue exceeding 3,000 SMMLV, or more than 20 employees. Additionally, a S.A.S. holding an SFC securities-brokerage license is always subject to mandatory audit regardless of size due to the public-interest nature of the regulated activity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS (NIIF) as adopted in Colombia through Decreto 2270 de 2019; SFC-regulated securities brokers belong to Grupo 1 and must apply complete IFRS together with the SFC's sectoral accounting instructions (FEN).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 2120 of 2021 and Decree 830 of 2021, the S.A.S. must identify every ultimate natural-person beneficiary based on 10% or greater ownership, control, or comparable entitlement, record them in the Libro de Beneficiarios Finales, and submit an annual electronic reconfirmation to the Cámara de Comercio by March 31. Any share transfer that changes the ultimate beneficial owner or control structure must be recorded in the UBO register and notified to the Cámara de Comercio within two months of the transaction.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Final Beneficiaries (Libro de Beneficiarios Finales)
Shareholders' Meeting Minutes Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Board of Directors Minutes Book (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva, when a board is constituted)
Statutory Audit and Revisor Fiscal Minutes Book (Libro de Actas de Revisor Fiscal)
Accounting Books and Supporting Corporate Documents

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500–10,000 per annum for a licensed S.A.S. securities broker, including full IFRS audit opinion

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% general CIT rate for FY2024–FY2025 (Art. 240 Estatuto Tributario), increased to an effective 40% for financial-sector entities, including securities brokerages, via the 5% financial surcharge (sobretasa) applicable for tax years 2023–2027 under Ley 2277/2022 (rate applies on taxable income computed under ordinary rules prior to the surcharge).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general income-tax holiday applies to ISIC 6611 retail securities brokerage. Available preferences: (i) 20% preferential CIT rate for companies operating within a declared Zona Franca; (ii) income-tax deduction equal to 100% of investments in science, technology, and innovation (limited to 25% of taxable income, with the ratio temporarily modified by Ley 2277/2022); (iii) 130% deduction for payroll of new employees under 28 years of age; (iv) 50% deduction for reforestation and certain environmental investments. None of these reduce the financial-sector surcharge. Also note Colombia imposes a minimum effective tax rate (gross taxable margin floor) — for FY2025 onward a 15% minimum rate under the 'tasa mínima de tributación' mechanism compares the ordinary tax to 15% of the enhanced base (GIFF), and the higher amount is paid.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_regime_note: Losses generated from tax year 2017 onward may be carried forward indefinitely (no expiration) under Art. 147 E.T. as amended by Ley 1819/2016; losses generated before 2017 are subject to the former 8-year limitation. Tax losses must be deducted in the order incurred and cannot generate a refund (only offset within the 5-year statute of limitations for assessments).
corporate_income_tax_regime.advance_payment_rule: Colombian SAS taxpayers are obliged to compute an advance of CIT (anticipo a título de renta) at 25% of the current-year tax, due in two installments alongside the annual return and the following year; the DIAN may set the installments in the annual calendar.
corporate_income_tax_regime.presumptive_income_note: Renta presuntiva (minimum taxable income based on net equity) was eliminated for FY2024 onward by Ley 2277/2022, reducing the compliance burden for the brokerage's proprietary investment portfolio.
corporate_income_tax_regime.special_industry_rate_note: As a securities brokerage holding a license from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC), the entity is classified as a 'sociedad comisionista de bolsa de valores' or 'empresa de intermediación de valores' and is captured by the financial-sector surcharge; verify the exact decree enumeration of Art. 240 E.T. before final computation.
